delivery: Calm opening; stress different suppliers and human next step
script: One tender feed can mean different things for different suppliers. TenderVerdict turns every notice into a clear human next step.
Everything runs locally on this Mac with synthetic demo data. Before the review starts, the app shows what was loaded and what is missing.

delivery: Give all three results equal weight; calm human close
script: Each notice gets one of three clear results: Open documents, Watch, or Reject. The reasons stay visible, and a person always makes the final decision.
The free version gives one complete supplier workflow: the full queue, visible reasons, source links, a review brief, and JSON export.

delivery: Stress Portfolio Workspace; keep access separate from decisions
script: RevenueCat unlocks Portfolio Workspace: comparison and full export for up to five supplier profiles. It never creates a score or makes a bid decision.
In a verified RevenueCat Test Store run, the SDK showed a test purchase screen. CustomerInfo confirmed the entitlement was active. It was not an App Store payment. No money was charged.
For judges, RevenueCat Judge Access checks the same entitlement without a purchase. A fresh CustomerInfo check, Restore, returning to the app, and a full relaunch all kept access active.
Synthetic demo data. No usable key stored. This is not a production billing. TenderVerdict is open-source macOS software under Apache 2.0.
